'''2007 Endor Regionals Buddy Walters DS Endor Operations''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Buddy Walters]] at [[2007 Endor Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Endor Operations / Imperial Outpost|Endor-D-endoroperations.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' Endor Operations
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS12]]
